annotation.evidence_span: if performance considerations support the use of weak entity-tags
annotation.interpretation_a: The server might choose to send a weak entity-tag if it believes doing so will improve performance, even if a strong entity-tag could also be sent without significant overhead.
annotation.interpretation_b: The server might only send a weak entity-tag if sending a strong entity-tag would demonstrably degrade performance to an unacceptable level.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'performance considerations support' is subjective and lacks a concrete threshold. Different implementations could reasonably interpret this differently, leading to varying behaviours regarding when to use weak vs. strong entity tags.
annotation.missing_information: The criteria for 'performance considerations' are not defined. What constitutes sufficient performance improvement to justify using a weak entity-tag is unclear.
